mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule_job_runtime ( job_group, job_name, last_actual_fire_time, last_result, last_duration_millis, safe_error_summary, executed_instance_id, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{runtime.jobGroup}, #{runtime.jobName}, #{runtime.lastActualFireTime}, #{runtime.lastResult}, #{runtime.lastDurationMillis}, #{runtime.safeErrorSummary}, #{runtime.executedInstanceId}, #{runtime.updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (job_group, job_name) DO UPDATE SET last_actual_fire_time = EXCLUDED.last_actual_fire_time, last_result = EXCLUDED.last_result, last_duration_millis = EXCLUDED.last_duration_millis, safe_error_summary = EXCLUDED.safe_error_summary, executed_instance_id = EXCLUDED.executed_instance_id, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
